tests.name: naive_two_child_left_join
tests.query: SELECT SUM(r.n) FROM r LEFT JOIN keyword k USING(id) LEFT JOIN category_addition c USING(id)

tests.name: preaggregate_left_join
tests.query: SELECT SUM(r.n) FROM r LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM keyword) k USING(id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM category_addition) c USING(id)

tests.name: deduplicate_cell_after_left_join
tests.query: SELECT SUM(n) FROM (SELECT r.id,MAX(r.n) n FROM r LEFT JOIN keyword k USING(id) LEFT JOIN category_addition c USING(id) GROUP BY r.id)

tests.name: sum_distinct_weight
tests.query: SELECT SUM(DISTINCT r.n) FROM r LEFT JOIN keyword k USING(id) LEFT JOIN category_addition c USING(id)

tests.name: count_distinct_cell
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) FROM r LEFT JOIN keyword k USING(id) LEFT JOIN category_addition c USING(id)

tests.name: naive_two_child_inner_join
tests.query: SELECT SUM(r.n) FROM r JOIN keyword k USING(id) JOIN category_addition c USING(id)

tests.name: eligible_source_semijoin
tests.query: SELECT SUM(n) FROM r WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM keyword k WHERE k.id=r.id) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM category_addition c WHERE c.id=r.id)

counting_unit: A reduced cell represents n source CSV rows. Cell ID is not a source statement ID. Results concern record-row weights and declared aggregate-cell membership.
